answer: An AI-agent economy managing logistics across a freight jetty resists Sybil attacks through clock-drift fingerprinting. Each agent anchors challenges to an onboard quartz crystal oscillator whose microscopic imperfections produce a unique timing skew. Attackers must purchase discrete hardware for each identity rather than virtualizing nodes, turning costless replication into a fable. However, ambient temperature shifts alter crystal resonance, risking false rejections of legitimate agents.
